description: Hidden deep within the Forest of the Green Lady, a camp of rebels plot to assassinate Bishop Roma at the festival! Sneak in and steal the Patreayl Knight Emblem on the table to bring back as evidence and warn Bishop Roma of their treachery.
name: Forest Secrets (MSQ)
completed: Hurry back to Highsteppe to warn Bishop Roma of his impending danger. He has taken over the Bell Tower in Highsteppe while waiting for the town celebration to begin, although you will have to speak with his guard before he will see you.
shortdesc: A group of rebels is camping to the NW in a clearing nearby. Investigate what's happening at their camp.
